name: Burning Blade Medallion
summary: Zureetha Fargaze sends young Horde initiates into the Burning Blade Coven cave in the Valley of Trials. They face a hidden cultist and seek a dark relic, the Burning Blade Medallion. Its presence points to demonic corruption taking root near the Horde.

sections.title: A Hidden Threat in the Valley
sections.body: Young orcs and trolls face trials of combat and survival in the Valley of Trials, while a menace gathers nearby. The warlock Zureetha Fargaze senses through divination that the vile familiars on the northern bluffs are only the vanguard of a darker presence. Deep in a nearby cavern, the Burning Blade cult has made a hidden coven, where its followers practice dark arts and keep dangerous relics of demonic power.

sections.title: Confronting Yarrog Baneshadow
sections.body: Yarrog Baneshadow, an orc warlock and Burning Blade agent, holds the medallion. He waits on an elevated ledge deep in the underground den, commanding fel beasts and wielding dark magic beyond the Valley overseers' watch. Defeating him and taking the medallion disrupts the cult's local leadership before its rituals spread farther into Durotar.

sections.title: The Lingering Shadow
sections.body: The medallion confirms Zureetha Fargaze's fears. The coven in the Valley of Trials has been dismantled, but the relic shows the Burning Blade is organized and deliberate. Its reach extends beyond the initiation grounds, and the nascent Horde faces broader demonic conspiracies across Durotar.

faq.q: Where do I find the Burning Blade Coven?
aliases: burning blade cave valley of trials
faq.answer: The Burning Blade Coven lies in a cave among the bluffs north and west of The Den in the Valley of Trials, surrounded by imp-like vile familiars.

faq.q: Who is carrying the Burning Blade Medallion?
faq.answer: Yarrog Baneshadow carries the medallion. He is deep in the cavern, on an elevated rock ledge beyond a shallow pool of water.
The Burning Blade is a treacherous cult of fel-corrupted orcs and warlocks devoted to demonic powers. Its members scheme against Thrall's new Horde from hidden dens and encampments.

faq.q: Why is the medallion so important to Zureetha Fargaze?
faq.answer: Zureetha Fargaze saw the medallion through divination. The item of power fuels the cult's dark rituals and proves demonic agents are infiltrating the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Does defeating Yarrog finish off the cult in Durotar?
faq.answer: No. Yarrog's defeat cleanses the cave in the Valley of Trials, but Zureetha warns that this coven is only a small cell and the Burning Blade has greater ambitions across Durotar.

faq.q: What happens after turning in the medallion?
faq.answer: After you slay Yarrog and recover the relic, you have proven your worth and are ready to leave the Valley of Trials. You are sent to report to Sen'jin Village on Durotar's southern coast.

angles.text: As a shaman, recovering the tainted relic helps Zureetha Fargaze expose demonic corruption defiling Durotar's earth.
As an orc, hunting Yarrog Baneshadow shows the new Horde's struggle to purge the old ways' lingering demonic taint from its training grounds.
As a warlock, confronting Yarrog reminds you of the dangers of rogue demonic worship beyond the sanctioned, carefully hidden pacts forged under Thrall's rule.
As a member of the Horde, this final trial marks your readiness to venture into Durotar's broader wilds and defend the young nation.
